action: Kaspersky advises players to pre-order or purchase games only through official console stores or authorized physical retailers, and never to download pre-load utilities from third-party websites or torrents.
date_note: Pokde.net (last updated 20 November) and Jagat Review's release text (dated 20 November) relay Kaspersky's figures; neither gives an earlier release day, and Kaspersky's own release was not found or read.

evidence.quote: Kaspersky has recorded 27,416 detections of malware and potentially unwanted applications tied to Grand Theft Auto VI between June and November 2026
tercatat 27.416 deteksi malware dan aplikasi yang berpotensi tidak diinginkan terkait dengan GTA VI secara global

exec: Kaspersky says it recorded 27,416 malware and unwanted-app detections tied to GTA VI from June to November 2026, spread through fake installers and phishing.
plain: Kaspersky says it found 27,416 cases of malware and unwanted apps tied to the new GTA VI game between June and November 2026, spread through fake installers, cheats and phishing.

key_findings: Kaspersky recorded 27,416 detections of malware and potentially unwanted applications tied to GTA VI worldwide between June and November 2026.
According to Jagat Review's copy of the release, attackers spread fake game installers, activation cheats and other fake apps, and Kaspersky also detected GTA VI-themed phishing.
recommendations: Pre-order or buy only through official console stores or authorized retailers; never download pre-load utilities from third-party sites or torrents.
Ignore claims of leaked playable builds, early pre-loads, activation keygens or online cheat engines for unreleased games.

summary: Kaspersky recorded 27,416 detections of malware and potentially unwanted applications tied to GTA VI worldwide between June and November 2026, according to its figures relayed by Pokde.net and Jagat Review. Jagat Review's copy of the release says attackers spread fake game installers, activation cheats and other fake apps, and that Kaspersky also detected GTA VI-themed phishing.
title: Kaspersky: 27,416 malware and unwanted-app detections tied to GTA VI since June

validation.note: Pokde.net and Jagat Review both relay one Kaspersky release (counted as one source); Kaspersky's own release was not found or read. Techcoffeehouse.com carries the same figure.
